summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Mako Mining Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, attaching a Statement of Executive Compensation. The filing discloses base salaries, annual bonus targets under a Scorecard plan, stock options, restricted share units, and deferred share units under the Omnibus Incentive Plan 2021 for named executive officers. It details 2025 key performance indicators and performance weighting between corporate and individual objectives. The filing is a routine compensation disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, tender, restructuring, or strategic change is announced. As a non-US filing, this 6-K serves as the equivalent of a domestic proxy statement compensation disclosure.
